title: Sleep & alertness
headline: Weekly sleep average has been below your usual range for 5 days in a row.
nasaRisk: Risk of Inadequate Sleep and Irregular Schedules
why: Isolation, artificial light and packed schedules disrupt sleep, which slows reactions.
measured: Wristband sleep tracking plus a 3-minute fatigue test.
action: Dim cabin lights 30 minutes earlier for 3 nights. Retake the fatigue test tomorrow.

title: Eyes & vision
headline: No new blurring or distortion since your last check.
nasaRisk: Risk of Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS)
why: In low gravity, fluid shifts toward the head and can change the shape of the eye.
measured: On-screen grid test; eye scans sent to Earth weekly.
action: Nothing to do. Next vision check in 4 days.

title: Mood & stress
headline: Mood and stress are steady and within your usual range.
nasaRisk: Risk of Behavioral Changes and Psychiatric Disorders
why: Months in a small, isolated space can lead to low mood, stress and conflict.

title: Heart & circulation
headline: Resting heart rate above your usual range on 3 of the last 5 mornings.
why: Without gravity, blood shifts toward the head and the heart can lose fitness.
measured: Chest strap or watch overnight; blood pressure cuff each morning.
action: Recheck sitting quietly tomorrow morning. If it stays high 3 more days, tell the crew medic.

title: Immune & temperature
headline: Temperature in your usual range. No symptoms reported.
nasaRisk: Risk of Altered Immune System Responses
why: Spaceflight weakens the immune system, and germs spread easily in a sealed habitat.

title: Hydration & kidneys
headline: Well hydrated, in line with your usual range.
why: Bone loss releases calcium, which raises kidney-stone risk if you drink too little.
measured: Camera photo against a colour chart.

title: Bones & muscles
headline: Exercise is on plan. Rest days are scheduled.
nasaRisk: Risk of Reduced Cardiorespiratory and Musculoskeletal Fitness
why: With little gravity to work against, bones and muscles weaken without exercise.
